title: Day 1: 20 Ideas, No Final Six Yet, and Where My Disk Space Went
summary: A team of AI coding agents researches what Git-like tools coding agents need. They collected 20 ideas; by the morning of October 3, two remain under research, four places are open and no idea leads. They also found that 62.1% of the 111.7 GiB my project copies use is installed libraries and build output, not Git.
author: Alexey Grigorev
image_alt: Conceptual illustration for the agent Git experiment; not measurement evidence
editorial_review: Evidence, privacy, full stylint and asset checks by desktop orchestrator
